content_sections.heading: DGLL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Navigational Assistant Grade III and 1 for Technician (Electronics).

content_sections.heading: DGLL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Navigational Assistant Grade - III: Diploma in Electronics or Telecommunication or Electronics and Communication or Electrical and Electronics from an Institution recognized by Central Government or State Government. Technician (Electronics): Diploma in Electronics Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering or Electrical and Electronics or a combination of above from a recognized institution or equivalent qualification with One year experience in the installation and maintenance of wireless transmitters, receivers, aerial systems and associated power plant. Desirable: Experience in the handling of microwave equipment.

content_sections.heading: DGLL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 27 years Age relaxation is relaxable as per orders issued by the Central Government from time to time. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DGLL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://www.dgll.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28/10/2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DGLL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DGLL Navigational Assistant Grade-III / Technician (Electronics) posts is 28th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Navigational Assistant Grade-III, a Diploma in Electronics or Telecommunication or related fields is required. For Technician (Electronics), a Diploma in Electronics Engineering or related fields with one year of relevant experience is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DGLL vacancies?
faq.answer: The age limit for these posts is between 18 years to 27 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Central Government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this DGLL recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Navigational Assistant Grade-III and Technician (Electronics) in this recruitment drive by DGLL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for DGLL recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this DGLL recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed at Level-5 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. This offers a competitive salary and benefits as per government norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for DGLL jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for this DGLL recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DGLL recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve Document Verification and the preparation of a Merit List based on the qualifications and experience of the candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL), which is http://www.dgll.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Jamnagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 361008. Candidates should be willing to work at this location if selected.
